budget_reachability.core_formula: For exactly one Edit with no inputs/captures: initial E + pre-leaf E + post-leaf L + final F, each traversal <=64 MiB. Therefore 2E+L+F <=256 MiB < unchanged512 MiB staged cap, with no integer overflow possible from the bounded sum.
budget_reachability.pre_leaf: Initial and pre-leaf serialize the identical immutable entry before any mutation. A new numeric pre-leaf wire refusal cannot arise after successful initial admission for this shape.
budget_reachability.post_leaf: An exact hit reuses a result whose original post-leaf serializer succeeded. A changed entry/request falls back and can newly fail the real post-result64-MiB cap.
budget_reachability.final: Outer revision is independent current authority. Assignment after the visitor can enlarge bytes (existing IDs1..128 ASCII); unchanged final serializer/charge and net_transaction still execute. Public changed-outer request parity checks complete bytes/edits and forward/inverse restoration; private exact-cap hit checks final refusal after1visit.
budget_reachability.store_formula: One eligible Edit has no captured checkpoints. Store processed entry+next <=128 MiB, below unchanged512 MiB; checkpoint charge remains0. Existing other-shape cumulative checks are retained.
budget_reachability.tests_distinguished: The public MAX_COMPOUND_STEPS/duplicate/RestoreSnapshot cases are constructor/identity tests, not evidence of a cumulative byte refusal. New private boundary test uses actual64-MiB limits and legal escaped labels, no lowered ceiling; its final hit comes from private application/sealing helper, not an end-to-end returned SemanticPlan.

validation_reused: A hit reuses one exact successful pure leaf application's request checks, reducer arithmetic, bindings/capture/split/phase/marks/lineage/pruning/timed-basis work, and leaf result/patch validation. Those pure leaf checks are intentionally not independently rerun.
independent_current_authority_executed: Core outer/leaf revision and transaction/ledger checks, all cumulative wire/work charges, explicit TLS boundaries, every host visitor, final aggregate validation, and Store current head/bank/frozen/allocation/media/analysis/corrections/preparation/codec/inverse/SQL/durability/history authority still execute.
